G'oya

Ikki ish: raqamni bir xil ko'rinishga keltirish va har bir guruhning birinchi kartasini topish. Har xil yozilgan raqamlarning umumiy qismi oxirgi 9 raqam (operator kodi va abonent raqami), 998 va belgilar esa bor yoki yo'q. Guruhning birinchisini oyna funksiyasi FIRST_VALUE beradi.

Yechim

WITH c AS (
  SELECT id, opened_on, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(phone, ' ', ''), '+', ''), '-', '') AS d
  FROM cards
  WHERE phone IS NOT NULL
),
k AS (
  SELECT id, opened_on, SUBSTR(d, LENGTH(d) - 8) AS p
  FROM c
),
r AS (
  SELECT id, FIRST_VALUE(id) OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY opened_on, id) AS main_id
  FROM k
)
SELECT id, main_id
FROM r
WHERE id <> main_id

SUBSTR(d, LENGTH(d) - 8) oxirgi 9 belgini oladi: 12 raqamli satrda 4-belgidan, 9 raqamlida 1-belgidan. Manfiy boshlanish nuqtasi ishlatilmagan, chunki PostgreSQL va SQLite uni turlicha tushunadi.

Tuzoqlar

WHERE phone IS NOT NULL ni tushirib qoldirish oson. PARTITION BY NULL larni bitta guruhga yig'adi, shunda raqamsiz hamma kartalar bitta "mijoz"ga aylanadi:

Noto'g'riWITH c AS (
  SELECT id, opened_on, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(phone, ' ', ''), '+', ''), '-', '') AS d
  FROM cards
),
k AS (
  SELECT id, opened_on, SUBSTR(d, LENGTH(d) - 8) AS p
  FROM c
),
r AS (
  SELECT id, FIRST_VALUE(id) OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY opened_on, id) AS main_id
  FROM k
)
SELECT id, main_id
FROM r
WHERE id <> main_id

Asosiy kartani MIN(id) bilan tanlash ham noto'g'ri: kartalar bazaga eski tizimdan ko'chirilgan bo'lsa, id tartibi ochilish sanasi tartibiga mos kelmaydi.
